data.description:
The P7 Dash power-up needs adjusting to align with the game's design philosophy: all power-ups should be collectable, not permanent.

Current state (§4.4, GDD): P7 is a permanent, always-available ability activated by Space bar to dash/teleport away from the nearest enemy in the opposite direction, with a 3-second cooldown.

Desired changes:
- P7 should be a collectable power-up (dropped by enemies like P1–P6), not a permanent core ability
- Instead of dashing, P7 should teleport the player in the direction of travel to a safe location
- Upon reappearing, the player gains a Phase Shift effect (intangibility) for safety
data.title: Redesign P7 Dash: make collectable teleport power-up
